what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Malawi in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 622 Malawian asylum seekers in South Africa, 35.0% of all asylum seekers from Malawi.
Refugees from Malawi, a separate group, live mostly in Ireland, the United Kingdom, Canada and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Malawi, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2007 to 2008, 2012 and 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 137 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 8171, at the end of 2007 and 2008, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
